prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized glacier-face region marker. Flat app-icon geometry. A
stepped vertical cliff profile — two or three rectangular steps
cascading down like a terraced ice wall, each step a different pale
palette color (cyan-white, light blue, mid-blue) so the stepping
reads clearly. Below the last step, a short horizontal band in a
darker palette blue indicating water or shadow at the base.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, bold crisp vector geometry readable at 16px. A stepped vertical glacier-face silhouette composed of two to three stacked rectangular terrace blocks cascading downward — the topmost block filled with bright white (#FFFFFF), the middle block in vivid pure blue (#0000FF), the lowest block in a slightly deeper blue-black tone, each step offset slightly to the right to convey a descending ice cliff profile. Below the final step, a short flat horizontal band in solid black (#000000) representing water or base shadow. Strong color separation between each tier, flat fills with sharp crisp edges, zero gradients, zero brushwork, zero texture. Every block reads as a distinct clean shape at minimum icon size.
